recognize_zh: 三個骨髓抽吸片視野中都可見小型巨核細胞，核為單一圓形、未分葉且偏心，外觀像大型漿細胞（plasmacytoid），位於骨髓小粒與脂肪旁，是 del(5q) MDS 的典型小型單葉巨核細胞。
features: Small megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated (monolobated) eccentric nuclei
Plasmacytoid appearance: moderate gray-blue to lilac cytoplasm around an off-center nucleus
Megakaryocytes located within or adjacent to cellular marrow particles with abundant fat
Background granulocytic and erythroid precursors with grossly normal maturation
No obvious increase in blasts in these low-to-intermediate power fields
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (three panels) show cellular particles admixed with fat. Megakaryocytes are readily identified and include many small forms with round, non-lobated, eccentrically placed nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, imparting a plasmacytoid appearance. Background erythroid and granulocytic precursors appear relatively unremarkable, and blasts are not increased at this magnification, although fine dysplastic detail cannot be assessed at this power. In conjunction with cytogenetic demonstration of an isolated 5q deletion, findings are consistent with myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q).

ddx.dx: Micromegakaryocytes of other MDS or CML
ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes in other MDS/CML are very small (lymphocyte-sized) with dense nuclei, often with separated lobes, and CML shows BCR::ABL1; isolated del(5q) on karyotype is the discriminator.
Plasma cells are smaller with clock-face chromatin, a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, whereas these megakaryocytes have granular lilac cytoplasm and platelet budding.
ET megakaryocytes are large and hyperlobated with abundant mature cytoplasm, not small and monolobated.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism and nucleoli rather than isolated megakaryocytes within particles.
